captions.title: Menu, then Buyers
captions.line: Everyone you have sent us, and where each one has got to.

captions.title: Tap the plus
captions.line: Top right. One short form, not a stepper.

captions.title: Their name and number
captions.line: We call this number, so make sure they are expecting us.

captions.title: Find what they liked
captions.line: Type a few letters. Leave it out if they have not picked one yet.

captions.title: An estate needs one more answer
captions.line: Which one inside it. Tick every option they asked about, not just one.

captions.title: Sold out stays on the list
captions.line: It is shown, not hidden. Somebody asking for the one that is gone is worth knowing.

captions.title: Anything we should know
captions.line: Optional, and the most useful thing on the form.

captions.title: Send it to AV Homes
captions.line: We call them, book the viewing and close it.

captions.title: Watch every step here
captions.line: Every move comes with the reason for it, in our own words.
